name: Columbia Gas East Side Expansion
researcher_notes: No existing row: roster has Columbia Gas Transmission system row P0169 plus project rows (P2516, P2556, P3188, P3189, P4446-4448, P7999), none is East Side. Row is an expansion row under the parent system name. A FERC environmental assessment notice published in the Federal Register on 8 September 2014 (docket CP14-17) says about 19.1 miles of 20- and 26-inch loop to deliver 312,000 dekatherms per day. The notice says facilities are in Pennsylvania, New Jersey, New York and Maryland, but the loop pipe is in Pennsylvania and New Jersey per the consolidator note; the exact endpoints were not located, so Start and End are state level only. The EIA pipeline projects release for August 2026, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel rows 800 and 804, lists the East Side Expansion Project as Completed, in service October 2015, 19 miles, 312 million cubic feet per day, cost 269 million dollars, FERC CP14-17. EIA is a second origin only partly independent of FERC. Length is 30.7 km, above the 25 km threshold. Capacity is stated in the source unit Dth/d; EIA gives 312 MMcf/d. Diameter 20 and 26 inches is multi-value; EIA row 804 shows 20. Owner uses the existing gazetteer entity Columbia Gas Transmission LLC. Parent and ProposalYear not researched. FIDStatus FID inferred from construction and completion, no separate source. Route not researched; likely no route available, human routes work needed (FERC filings). Cost from EIA only.
